title: Fishing Loot Tweaks
description: Tweaked fishing loot tables for various styles of SMPs & events.
body:
These datapacks are designed to rebalance loot from fishing, for various styles of SMPs, servers and events.

Please download the correct version! 
The latest upload may not be what you are looking for.
Read the changelog of versions to decide which datapack is right for you.

Tweaked loot table for events
[For Minecraft Civ events](https://modrinth.com/datapack/fishing-loot-tweaks/version/kw64xKn6)

Nerfed loot table where only fish can be caught
[Only Fish](https://modrinth.com/datapack/fishing-loot-tweaks/version/1.0-FISH_ONLY)

Reverts the 'Open waters' mechanics from 1.16, allowing treasure to be caught from any water source and bringing back the legendary afk fish farms!
[Always Open Waters](https://modrinth.com/datapack/fishing-loot-tweaks/version/1.0-OpenWaters)
